g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Amazon EKS with Karpenter autoscaling and private endpoints

g.title: None.None.Node.37
g.text: Customers resolve the application's domain in Route 53
Route 53 sends them to an Application Load Balancer in one of three availability zones
The load balancer forwards to pods on the NodePool's On-Demand or Spot nodes
Pods read and write orders in Aurora PostgreSQL
EC2 issues a two-minute Spot interruption warning and the EventBridge rule queues it
The Karpenter controller reads the warning from SQS
Karpenter calls EC2 through the interface endpoint to launch a replacement node
The new node pulls image layers from S3 through the gateway endpoint
Karpenter drains the interrupted Spot node and its pods move to the new node
